keyed.SMD.Section.buildings.Desc: Default bills for workbenches, default filters for shelves and other storage, default plants for hydroponics. The Defaults button on buildings and in the Bills tab.
keyed.SMD.Section.zones.Desc: Default filters for new stockpile and dumping zones, default plant for new growing zones. The Defaults button on zones.
keyed.SMD.Section.pawns.Desc: Colonist presets (schedule, work, policies, hostility, medical care) and applying the default preset once to every new colonist. The Defaults button on colonists.
keyed.SMD.Section.policies.Desc: A saved set of outfit, drug, food and reading policies that you can apply in any colony, and optionally to every new game.
keyed.SMD.Section.colony.Desc: Medical care defaults per group, auto home area, auto rebuild and manual work priorities, saved once and applied to new games.
keyed.SMD.Section.library.Desc: The cross-save library file that holds every preset, named profiles and share strings for importing and exporting.
keyed.SMD.Setting.smd.autoApplyOnPlace.Desc: A newly built workbench gets the bills you saved as its default.
A newly built shelf or other storage gets its default filter and priority; a moved or reinstalled one keeps its own.
keyed.SMD.Setting.smd.plantAutoApplyOnBuild.De: A newly built hydroponics basin, plant pot or other plant grower gets its default plant.
keyed.SMD.Setting.smd.benchFamilies.Desc: A building without its own preset uses the default of a close relative, e.g. the fueled stove uses the electric stove's bills.
keyed.SMD.Setting.smd.billMatchStockpileByName: Bills that drop in or count in a specific stockpile find a stockpile of the same name again in the new colony.
keyed.SMD.Setting.smd.showGizmo.Desc: Shows the Defaults button when a workbench, shelf or plant grower is selected.
keyed.SMD.Setting.smd.showTabButton: Defaults button in the Bills tab
keyed.SMD.Setting.smd.showTabButton.Desc: Shows the Defaults button inside the Bills tab of a workbench (a small icon when Nice Bill Tab is used).
keyed.SMD.Setting.smd.zoneAutoApplyOnCreate.De: A stockpile or dumping zone you draw gets the default you saved for that kind of zone.
keyed.SMD.Setting.smd.growingAutoApplyOnCreate: Default plant on new growing zones
A growing zone you draw gets the default plant and the sow and cut switches you saved.
keyed.SMD.Setting.smd.autoApplyToNewPawns: Apply the default preset to new colonists
keyed.SMD.Setting.smd.autoApplyToNewPawns.Desc: Every colonist who joins (start, recruit, wanderer, quest, birth) gets the default preset once. Colonists you already had are never changed.
keyed.SMD.Setting.smd.pawnIncludeChildren.Desc: Children get the preset too; their work priorities are set once they are old enough to work.
keyed.SMD.Setting.smd.pawnSkipWorkUnderFreeWil: With Free Will or Free-ish Will, work priorities are skipped for colonists that mod manages; everything else still applies.
keyed.SMD.Setting.smd.pawnShowGizmo.Desc: Shows the Defaults button when a colonist is selected.
keyed.SMD.Setting.smd.pawnApplyWork.Desc: The work tab priorities (and manual priority numbers).
keyed.SMD.Setting.smd.pawnApplyApparel.Desc: The apparel policy, matched by name or recreated.
keyed.SMD.Setting.smd.pawnApplyDrug.Desc: The drug policy, matched by name or recreated.
keyed.SMD.Setting.smd.pawnApplyFood.Desc: The food restriction, matched by name or recreated.
keyed.SMD.Setting.smd.pawnApplyReading.Desc: The reading policy, matched by name or recreated.
keyed.SMD.Setting.smd.pawnApplyHostility.Desc: Flee, attack or ignore when enemies come close.
keyed.SMD.Setting.smd.pawnApplyMedical.Desc: The medicine the colonist may receive, and self-tend.
keyed.SMD.Setting.smd.policyAutoApplyOnNewGame: Apply the saved policies to new games
When a new colony starts, the saved policy set is created and starting colonists move to its defaults.
keyed.SMD.Setting.smd.colonyApplyOnNewGame: Apply the saved colony settings to new games
keyed.SMD.Setting.smd.colonyApplyOnNewGame.Des: When a new colony starts, the saved medical defaults, auto home area, auto rebuild and manual priorities are set (only if you saved any).
keyed.SMD.Setting.smd.nativeRaiseBillCap.Desc: Lifts vanilla's limit of 15 bills per workbench without another mod. Not used while No Max Bills is installed.
keyed.SMD.Setting.smd.maxBillsCap.Desc: The limit while more than 15 bills are allowed (also used when restoring defaults under No Max Bills). Many bills cost performance.
keyed.SMD.Setting.smd.filterIntent.Desc: Saved filters remember whole categories, so items a mod adds to a category later are included. Off = exact item lists as in 1.x.
keyed.SMD.Setting.smd.compatNiceBillTab: Nice Bill Tab: refresh after applying
keyed.SMD.Setting.smd.compatNiceBillTab.Desc: Tells Nice Bill Tab to redraw its list, so applied bills show up at once.
keyed.SMD.Setting.smd.compatPrf.Desc: S.A.L. assemblers get their bills after their recipes appear, storage machines and splitters get their defaults.
keyed.SMD.Setting.smd.compatBlueprints.Desc: With Blueprints Forked, a blueprint remembers each building's bills and storage settings and recreates them when built.
keyed.SMD.Preset.automatic.Desc: Everything on: new workbenches, shelves, zones and colonists get their defaults by themselves.
keyed.SMD.Preset.manual.Desc: Nothing happens by itself; you apply presets with the Defaults button.
keyed.SMD.Preset.buildings.Desc: Bills, shelves and zones; colonists, policies and colony settings are left alone.
keyed.SMD.Compat.NiceBillTab.What: The Defaults button sits as an icon in its bill window; applied bills show up at once.
keyed.SMD.Compat.NiceInventoryTab.What: Its bundled bill tab is supported the same way as Nice Bill Tab.
keyed.SMD.Compat.NoMaxBillsRedux.What: Owns the bill limit; Set my Defaults restores at most that many bills and adds no patch of its own.
keyed.SMD.Compat.ProjectRimFactoryRevived.What: Assemblers, storage machines and conveyor splitters get their defaults.
keyed.SMD.Compat.BlueprintsForked.What: Blueprints remember bills and storage settings, even across saves.
keyed.SMD.Compat.FreeWill.What: Work priorities are left to Free Will for the colonists it manages.
keyed.SMD.Compat.FreeishWill.What: Work priorities are left to Free-ish Will for the colonists it manages.
keyed.SMD.Compat.BetterWorkbenchManagement.Wha: Works side by side. A default bill uses the store mode saved in the preset, not BWM's own default.
keyed.SMD.Compat.CombatExtended.What: Fine: only vanilla schedule, work, policy and medical state is touched, never loadouts or ammo.
keyed.SMD.Compat.Ideology.What: A bill's style is saved with it and restored when that style exists.
keyed.SMD.Compat.Anomaly.What: Medical defaults for entities and ghouls are part of the colony settings.
